verdict.rationale: incident.io's Insights product provides period-over-period comparisons and dashboards (docs-18/32/64), and its case study claims 'strengthened reliability company-wide' (docs-44), but the evidence pack lacks concrete detail on MTTA/MTTR trend tracking specifically, on-call health metrics, or incident load trending as named leadership-facing analytics — only generic 'Insights' mentions with period comparison toggles are documented. missing for 10: explicit MTTA/MTTR metric definitions and dashboards, on-call health scorecards, incident load/volume trend reporting, and independent validation that leaders use these to measure improvement over time.
